command.name: Cobalt Flame
verbatim: Rounds 1, 4, 7: Deal Fire Damage to 1 Enemy in any lane, prioritizes targets that deal Physical Damage, excluding Basic Attacks (Damage Rate: +95%). 50% chance to reduce Damage Dealt by -10% for 2 round(s), doubled to -20% if the target deals Physical Damage.
Rounds 3, 6, 9: Deal Physical Damage to 1 Enemy in the same lane (Damage Rate: +60%).

vanguard.name: Champion's Brilliance
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard, increase your Strength, Intelligence, and Instinct by +15. Reduce Damage Received by -8% of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

habits.name: Sharpened Beauty
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase your Physical and Fire Damage Dealt by +7% until the end of the round. Double these effects (+14%) if you are above 75% Troop Capacity or if you have Advantage.

habits.name: Blazing Leader
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase the Fire Damage Dealt by +10% of 1 Ally in any lane (prioritizes the Left Flank) until the end of combat.

habits.name: Molten Armor
habits.verbatim: Start of Odd-numbered Rounds: 25% chance to increase your Fire Damage Dealt by +12% and reduce the Physical Damage Received by -12% of 2 other Allies in any lane. If you are afflicted with Panic, also apply the reduced Physical Damage Received effect to yourself. Each effect lasts for 2 round(s).

habits.name: Clever Maneuver
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase Intelligence by +18% and Initiative by +9% of the Ally with the highest Intelligence until the end of combat. Both effects are enhanced by Instinct.

habits.name: The Blue Queen
habits.verbatim: Start of Odd-numbered Rounds: 40% chance to reduce the Damage Received by -10% and increase the Intelligence (enhanced by Intelligence) by +15% of 1 other Ally in any lane that deals Fire Damage for 2 round(s). If you are above 75% Troop Capacity, double the Damage Received reduction (-20%) and Intelligence increase (+30%).
